summary: Dependency-confusion scope-squat with install-time host beacon to OOB collectors
details: @myorder-frontend-commons/analytics ships a poc.js payload wired to all three npm lifecycle hooks (preinstall, install, postinstall). On install, poc.js collects hostname, username, platform/arch/release, cwd, Node version, package version, npm_lifecycle_event, and the names of CI environment variables present, then issues HTTP GETs to a hardcoded interactsh subdomain (db4jftohu4noreqdanngpnb3ger45ykrt.oast.fun) and a nip.io-wrapped bare IP (80-190-83-27.nip.io / 80.190.83.27). A hex-encoded hostname|user|version label is prepended as a DNS subdomain so execution is leaked via DNS resolution even when HTTP egress is blocked. The package self-identifies as a dependency-confusion test against an internal @myorder-frontend-commons scope, so any installer whose resolver pulls this public package ahead of an internal registry entry has host and CI identifiers exfiltrated to third-party out-of-band collectors.
